info.name: FreshFlow Complete API Flows
info.description: Complete collection generated from the live FreshFlow OpenAPI document. Run numbered folders in the displayed order for the main flow; requests marked MANUAL are optional. Folder 90 contains state-dependent/manual requests; folder 99 contains destructive cleanup. The first request creates unique run variables. Request descriptions show the source OpenAPI operation, schema, query parameters, and prerequisites.
